title: Independently verify the P104 forward caller and target bindings (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Publishes an independent, source-bound audit of the **265-axis forward P104 caller and its productive target bindings** in [PR #5545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545). This closes one finite validation layer under retained premises. **No new construction, paid-profile change, κ gain, global ceiling or full parent admission is claimed.**

The checker covers 7,488 actual entry/exit contacts and their composed local block coefficients, the complete 32-bank free-Laurent caller, 3,328 main input/output canonicalizers and final corrections, 527 native helper normalizers, 208 intrinsic main adapters, and 9,486 fresh helper identities. It emits all 3,120 whole-idle jobs and 1,560 corrected positive-child query recipes. The complete invoice is unchanged: **69,912 paid jobs and 12,814 independent productive fields**.

The [proof/accounting argument](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6125c07ae8ba4b8550e2a0a28a2c6be503153059/research/p104-caller-independent-audit/PROOF.md) binds actual route phases and target input aliases. It keeps scalar signs outside digit-column tensor powers and excludes scratch and spectators from productive credit. Signed-Pauli equality plus an independently executed exact dense phase anchor checks the native target maps. Source compiler and literal circuit definitions are credited reuse.

The separate 127,292,680 ordinary figure is an **abstract address/phase/scalar pass bound under retained per-pass/tape costs**, below the source allowance 184,647,552. It is not newly funded machine work, a precision theorem, recursive rank credit or a κ reserve.

The all-input/all-width local native ABI and untouched paid-map correctness remain inherited. Owned query cleanup is checked against the fixed template; the erasure framework is not independently proved. Contact inverses are not a complete-caller raw inverse transpose. Full raw dual, uniform precision/tape/storage, compiler reserve, complete outer conjunction and human/formal acceptance remain open. Five framework assumptions remain. See [review limits](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6125c07ae8ba4b8550e2a0a28a2c6be503153059/research/p104-caller-independent-audit/REVIEW.md).

## Task and overlap

Task `scalar-to-moment`, priority revision 7, **changed scope / partial**, from the explicit user assignment to validate this pending caller. The card's positive paid-profile gain gate is not claimed met. [TASK.json](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6125c07ae8ba4b8550e2a0a28a2c6be503153059/research/p104-caller-independent-audit/TASK.json) preserves the original card and states the actual scope.

Publication: `6125c07ae8ba4b8550e2a0a28a2c6be503153059`, directly based on canonical `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Reviewed PR #5545: `18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc`; predecessor #5544: `e2a6cce2f9db5a2c5f9714f4b9e5292dd3a10581`. The source author [released scope and requested independent review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19169220). Current main guidance, relevant source/PR discussion and bounded changed-PR checks were refreshed. No competing successor appeared in that coverage; hidden/unpublished work is not covered exhaustively.

Our [PR #5548](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5548), head `b038f9d9b5cf0ce92184da909e57a3be476fc812`, covers the earlier local contact/native replacement and scoped repeated-H5 ceiling. This PR adds the forward caller/target layer. It reuses only the dense interpreter needed here and authenticates previous receipts without rerunning those older audits. The predecessor construction and packages are unchanged.

The source-bound capsule retains the exact successful checker, complete expected output and authenticated inputs. Pending source bytes are included for offline replay; no pending Git object or network is required at runtime. Canonical compiler, circuit and phase sources remain declared live inputs. Source-history checks authenticate those registered pins, not merger or acceptance of the pending construction.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3, standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-caller-independent-audit --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-caller-independent-audit
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-caller-independent-audit --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_P104_FORWARD_CALLER_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT`.

- Metadata/pins and exact published-commit/source-history checks passed for all **38 package/input files**. Remote tree equals the checked local tree; canonical main is the direct parent.
- Original normal/optimized pair passed under the unchanged shared guard in **100.917 s / 82.35 MiB**, within 150 s / 512 MiB. Every **5,990,419 scientific output bytes** matches, zero scientific exclusions. SHA256: `b51a7d19c10faea7d569a48e9536db8ba1e7418f8dd8dfb25646cc87cc9c4009`.
- The registered portable normal/optimized replay passed in **103.299 s / 123.77 MiB** under the same outer cap, comparing every byte with the frozen original output.
- A relocated read-only, Git-free optimized export with spaces in its path and empty PATH passed in **47.173 s / 90.91 MiB**. All **39 exported files** remained unchanged.
- Ten scoped controls reject wrong route, omitted contact translation, nonzero absolute phase, exterior sign error, lost idle, helper alias collision, missing final translation, scratch/source collision, missing inverse-Q correction and packed-exponent overflow. Negative-power cancellation also passes. Control scope is explicit; not every control is a full mutated-source replay.
- Separate on-disk canonical-source and expected-receipt corruptions fail before the scientific worker. An injected source exception was not imported. A fresh private bytecode namespace also isolates the scientific subprocess.

The first checker exceeded 512 MiB before a result; its frozen code and closeout are retained as history. The successful revision bounds the phase cache, packs all 34 exact exponents with overflow rejection, and streams output. It retains all 265 axes and full matrix coverage; no floating or finite-order shortcut is used. Original operational stage traces are separate from scientific output. Mode equality is reproducibility, not independent human review. Hosted CI for this PR is separate from these completed local receipts and from #5548's hosted success.

New independent checker, memory-bounded representation, source custody and publication for Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.

## Open next questions

The [structured questions](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6125c07ae8ba4b8550e2a0a28a2c6be503153059/research/p104-caller-independent-audit/TASK.json) and [seven-field handoff](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6125c07ae8ba4b8550e2a0a28a2c6be503153059/research/p104-caller-independent-audit/HANDOFF.md) specify relevance, first steps and blockers.

1. Review target input aliases and the ordinary-cost premises, then choose one missing native/complete-caller-dual obligation. The actual raw inverse transpose and untouched paid native foundation matter before invoking parent funding.
2. Bind precision/tape/storage, erasure and retained compiler/outer reserves to this fixed complete caller. The abstract pass census is not that conjunction.
3. For κ≥.0033, nominate one broader paid-path mechanism with complete optimistic costs and a small physical falsifier. This unchanged invoice does not lift #5548's repeated-H5 raw ceiling (.003106074473,.003106074474).

This completed layer stops after publication. No new construction scan, recurring worker, merge or selected change is authorized by the submission.
